title: 橋梁伸縮縫安裝與更換~Bridge expansion-joint installation and replacement
focus: 以伸縮量計算、安裝溫度預設、錨碇與疲勞細部控制，讓伸縮縫跟上橋梁變形並能在通車條件下更換~Movement calculation, temperature presetting, anchorage and fatigue detailing that let a joint follow the bridge's movements and be replaced under traffic
summary: 從溫度、乾縮、潛變與活載造成的梁端位移出發，決定伸縮縫型式與間隙數，檢核中梁輪載衝擊與疲勞，再處理錨碇箱與後澆混凝土、安裝溫度預設、通車條件下的分幅更換、出廠疲勞與防水試驗、現場間隙—溫度量測，最後以止水排水維護與生命週期更換策略交接，並以新 Tappan Zee 橋的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫、Øresund 橋的旋轉橫梁伸縮縫更換與漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋伸縮縫翻修為案例。~Starting from girder-end movements due to temperature, shrinkage, creep and live load, choose the joint type and number of gaps and check centre-beam wheel impact and fatigue, then handle anchorage boxes and blockout concrete, temperature presetting at installation, staged replacement under traffic, factory fatigue and watertightness tests and field gap–temperature measurements, and finally hand over with seal and drainage maintenance and a life-cycle replacement strategy, using the LR18 modular joints of the new Tappan Zee crossing, the swivel-joist joint replacement on the Øresund Bridge and the joint rehabilitation of Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge as cases.

units.title: 梁端位移來源與伸縮量需求~Sources of girder-end movement and the required range
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫位於兩段結構之間，必須容納梁端的縱向伸縮、轉角與少量橫向及豎向位移，同時讓車輪平順通過、阻止雨水與鹽分落到支承與墩帽上。梁端位移的主要來源是溫度變化，混凝土橋另有乾縮與潛變造成的單向縮短，長跨橋還有活載、風與煞車造成的往復位移，耐震設計可能再加上地震位移。伸縮量由固定點到伸縮縫之間的伸縮長度決定，所以支承配置與固定點位置改變，伸縮縫需求也隨之改變。~An expansion joint sits between two structural parts and must accommodate longitudinal movement, rotation and some transverse and vertical displacement of the girder ends, while letting wheels pass smoothly and keeping rain and salt off bearings and pier caps. The main source of movement is temperature; concrete bridges add one-way shortening from shrinkage and creep, long spans add cyclic movements from live load, wind and braking, and seismic design may add earthquake displacement. The movement is governed by the expansion length between the fixed point and the joint, so changing the bearing layout or fixed point changes the joint demand too.
units.model: 預力混凝土橋伸縮長度 L = 300 m：溫度 ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm；殘餘乾縮 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm；潛變 (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm。合計 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm，若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 274/80 ≈ 3.4，取 4 個間隙（320 mm）。數值為教學假設。~For a prestressed concrete bridge with an expansion length L = 300 m: temperature ΔL = αLΔT = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×50 = 150 mm; remaining shrinkage 200×10⁻⁶×300,000 = 60 mm; creep (5/35,000)×1.5×300,000 ≈ 64 mm. The total, 150 + 60 + 64 ≈ 274 mm, at 80 mm per modular gap needs 274/80 ≈ 3.4, so 4 gaps (320 mm). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 設計時列出位移計算表：伸縮長度、溫度範圍（依規範的有效溫度）、乾縮潛變的殘餘比例、活載與煞車位移、地震位移，並分開標示可逆與單向分量；與支承設計者核對固定點、活動支承行程與伸縮縫需求一致。~At design stage tabulate movements: expansion length, temperature range from the code's effective bridge temperature, remaining proportion of shrinkage and creep, live-load and braking movements and seismic displacement, marking reversible and one-way components separately; check with the bearing designer that the fixed point, bearing travel and joint demand are consistent.
units.failure: 若只以溫度計算伸縮量，忽略混凝土橋多年的乾縮與潛變縮短，伸縮縫數年後在冬季拉開超過行程，止水帶撕裂、中梁脫出控制系統；地震位移未考慮時，伸縮縫在大地震中被擠壓破壞，造成橋面落差阻礙救災通行。~Sizing the joint for temperature alone, ignoring years of shrinkage and creep in a concrete bridge, lets it open beyond its range in winter after a few years, tearing seals and pulling centre beams out of their control system; ignoring seismic displacement lets the joint be crushed in a major earthquake, leaving a step in the deck that blocks emergency traffic.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫只需要依照溫度變化計算伸縮量。~Joint movement only needs to be calculated from temperature change.
units.practice: 伸縮縫規格須列出各方向設計位移、轉角、可逆與單向分量、地震設計策略（容納或可犧牲），以及安裝時的預設計算方法，並與支承規格一起審查。~The joint specification must list design movements in each direction, rotations, reversible and one-way components, the seismic strategy (accommodate or sacrificial) and the presetting method, and be reviewed together with the bearing specification.

units.anchor: 中梁輪載衝擊~Centre-beam wheel impact
units.title: 輪載衝擊、煞車力與疲勞~Wheel impact, braking force and fatigue
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫直接承受車輪衝擊：輪胎從橋面滾到鋼梁再滾回橋面，路面的高低差與間隙造成衝擊，動態放大比一般橋面更大；車輛煞車與加速又在縫面上施加水平力。模組式伸縮縫的中梁像一根多跨連續梁，擱在間距約一公尺多的支撐梁上，每一次車輪通過都在中梁與支撐梁的焊接或連接處產生應力循環，所以疲勞是模組式伸縮縫最主要的結構問題，美國 NCHRP 的研究與 AASHTO 規範都要求以疲勞試驗驗證。~Expansion joints take wheel impact directly: as a tyre rolls from the deck onto steel beams and back, steps and gaps cause impact with larger dynamic amplification than elsewhere on the deck, and braking and acceleration apply horizontal forces at the surface. In a modular joint the centre beam acts as a multi-span continuous beam on support bars spaced a little over a metre apart, and every wheel passage cycles stress at the centre-beam-to-support-bar weld or connection, so fatigue is the main structural issue for modular joints; NCHRP research and AASHTO provisions call for verification by fatigue testing.
units.model: 輪載 75 kN 乘動態放大 1.3 為 97.5 kN；中梁支撐間距 s = 1.2 m，以連續梁近似 M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m；中梁斷面模數 2.0×10⁵ mm³ 時 σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa，每次重車輪通過形成一次接近此值的應力循環。數值為教學假設。~A 75 kN wheel times a 1.3 dynamic factor gives 97.5 kN; with centre-beam supports at s = 1.2 m and a continuous-beam approximation M ≈ P·s/6 = 97.5×1.2/6 ≈ 19.5 kN·m; for a section modulus of 2.0×10⁵ mm³, σ ≈ 19.5×10⁶/2.0×10⁵ ≈ 97.5 MPa, a stress cycle of about this size at every heavy wheel. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 製造商須提交依規範或認證指引完成的疲勞試驗報告（中梁、支撐梁與其連接），以及在設計交通量下的疲勞檢核；安裝後以平整度量測確認縫面與鋪面高差在允差內，因為高差會直接放大衝擊。~The manufacturer must submit fatigue test reports to the code or approval guideline for centre beams, support bars and their connections, plus a fatigue check for the design traffic; after installation, measure flushness to confirm the step between joint and pavement is within tolerance, since a step directly amplifies impact.
units.failure: 中梁與支撐梁的焊縫在重車反覆衝擊下疲勞斷裂，中梁局部鬆脫並發出撞擊聲，嚴重時中梁翹起成為行車危害；鋪面與縫面高差過大，衝擊加劇，使錨碇與後澆混凝土提早破壞。~The weld between centre beam and support bar cracks by fatigue under repeated heavy impacts, the centre beam works loose and bangs, and in severe cases lifts up as a traffic hazard; a large step between pavement and joint intensifies impact and destroys anchorages and blockout concrete early.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫只是鋪面上的蓋板，不需要做疲勞設計。~An expansion joint is just a cover plate in the pavement and needs no fatigue design.
units.practice: 採購規格要求依交通量分級的疲勞試驗與型式認證，並規定縫面與鋪面高差允差；重車比例高的路段應優先採用經試驗驗證的連接細部，並把伸縮縫列入每次例行檢查的必看項目。~Procurement should require fatigue testing and type approval graded by traffic, and a flushness tolerance between joint and pavement; routes with heavy truck traffic should favour connection details proven by testing, and joints are a mandatory item at every routine inspection.

units.anchor: 模組式中梁與支撐梁~Modular centre beams and support bars
units.title: 伸縮縫型式與模組式構造~Joint types and modular construction
units.mechanism: 小位移可用壓縮密封縫或條形止水縫，中等位移可用梳齒板，大位移則用模組式伸縮縫：多根中梁把總位移分成數個間隙，每個間隙以橡膠止水帶封閉，下方支撐梁擱在錨碇箱內並可滑動，彈性控制系統讓各間隙平均開合。另一種大位移形式是旋轉橫梁（swivel joist）伸縮縫，支撐橫梁可旋轉，能同時容納縱向、橫向與轉角位移。Øresund 橋的 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫以 15 個型材容納約 1,500 mm 位移，新 Tappan Zee 橋最大的 LR18 模組式伸縮縫有 18 個間隙、位移可達約 1.4 m。~Small movements use compression seals or strip seals, medium movements finger plates, and large movements modular joints: several centre beams divide the total movement into gaps sealed by elastomeric profiles, support bars below slide within anchorage boxes, and an elastic control system keeps the gaps opening evenly. Another large-movement form is the swivel-joist joint, whose support joists can rotate, accommodating longitudinal, transverse and rotational movement together. The Øresund Bridge's DS15 swivel-joist joint takes about 1,500 mm with 15 profiles, and the largest LR18 modular joints on the new Tappan Zee crossing have 18 gaps and movements up to about 1.4 m.
units.model: 每間隙平均位移 = 總位移/間隙數。Tappan Zee LR18：1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm（54 in/18 = 3 in）；Øresund DS15：1,500/15 = 100 mm；Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm、LR12 1,140 mm，皆約 95 mm/間隙。控制系統失效使一間隙承擔兩倍位移時，該間隙需約 156 至 200 mm，超過止水帶容許而撕裂。數值依公開資料換算，失效情境為教學假設。~Average movement per gap = total movement/number of gaps. Tappan Zee LR18: 1,400/18 ≈ 78 mm (54 in/18 = 3 in); Øresund DS15: 1,500/15 = 100 mm; Köhlbrand LR8 760 mm and LR12 1,140 mm, both about 95 mm per gap. If a failed control system lets one gap take twice its share, it needs about 156 to 200 mm, beyond the seal's capacity, and tears. Ratios are derived from public data; the failure case is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 依位移、交通量、噪音與維護需求比較型式，製造圖須標示間隙數、每間隙最大開口、控制系統型式與預設方法；出廠前在工廠以千斤頂開合全行程，量測各間隙是否均勻（例如差異不超過數公釐）。~Compare types by movement, traffic, noise and maintenance needs; shop drawings must show the number of gaps, maximum opening per gap, control-system type and presetting method; before dispatch, cycle the joint through its full range with jacks in the shop and measure gap uniformity, for example within a few millimetres.
units.failure: 控制系統彈簧老化或斷裂，各間隙開合不均，一個間隙長期全開、另一個全閉，止水帶被拉斷或擠出，碎石塞入閉合間隙使中梁無法移動，最終把位移強迫傳給錨碇。~Aged or broken control springs make gaps open unevenly, leaving one permanently wide and another closed; seals tear or extrude, debris packs into the closed gap so centre beams cannot move, and movement is finally forced onto the anchorages.
units.misconception: 模組式伸縮縫的間隙會自然平均開合，不需要控制系統。~Modular joint gaps open evenly by themselves without a control system.
units.practice: 伸縮縫型式選擇應以全生命週期考量，包括更換便利性（如可快速拆換的單元設計）；製造圖與出廠試驗紀錄須經設計單位審查，控制系統的備品與更換方法列入維護手冊。~Choose the joint type on whole-life grounds, including ease of replacement such as quickly removable units; shop drawings and factory test records are reviewed by the designer, and control-system spares and replacement methods go into the maintenance manual.

units.anchor: 錨碇箱與後澆混凝土~Anchorage boxes and blockout concrete
units.title: 錨碇細部與後澆混凝土養護~Anchorage details and blockout concrete curing
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫的力量經錨碇箱、錨筋或錨栓傳到橋面板與梁端：豎向衝擊、上拔與煞車水平力都要靠這些錨碇承受。新建時先在梁端預留凹槽（後澆槽），伸縮縫定位後再澆置高強度或快硬混凝土；更換工程則要鑿除舊後澆混凝土、處理鋼筋，再澆新混凝土。後澆混凝土強度發展決定何時可以開放交通，而強度發展又強烈依賴溫度，所以冬季更換工程的封閉時間往往比夏季長。~Joint forces pass through anchorage boxes, anchor bars or bolts into the deck slab and girder ends: vertical impact, uplift and horizontal braking all depend on them. In new construction a recess (blockout) is left at the girder end and filled with high-strength or rapid-hardening concrete after the joint is positioned; in replacements the old blockout concrete is broken out, the reinforcement treated and new concrete cast. Blockout strength gain decides when traffic can return, and strength gain depends strongly on temperature, so winter replacements often need longer closures than summer ones.
units.model: Nurse–Saul 成熟度 M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt，T₀ = −10°C。若後澆混凝土達到通車強度需 M = 900 °C·h：養護溫度 20°C 時每小時累積 30 °C·h，需 900/30 = 30 h；10°C 時每小時 20 °C·h，需 45 h，多 15 h。數值為教學假設。~Nurse–Saul maturity M = Σ(T − T₀)·Δt with T₀ = −10°C. If the blockout concrete reaches opening strength at M = 900 °C·h, curing at 20°C accumulates 30 °C·h per hour and needs 900/30 = 30 h; at 10°C it accumulates 20 °C·h per hour and needs 45 h, 15 h more. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以同一配比預先建立成熟度—強度曲線，現場在後澆槽埋設溫度感測器即時計算成熟度，並以同條件養護試體確認；錨筋與錨栓在澆置前逐一檢查位置、焊接與保護層，舊混凝土界面清潔、濕潤並檢查無鬆動骨材。~Establish a maturity–strength curve for the same mix in advance, embed temperature sensors in the blockout to compute maturity in real time and confirm with field-cured specimens; check every anchor bar and bolt for position, welding and cover before casting, and make sure the old concrete interface is clean, damp and free of loose aggregate.
units.failure: 趕在強度未達前開放交通，後澆混凝土在錨筋周圍碎裂，伸縮縫數週內就鬆動並發出撞擊聲；舊混凝土鑿除不徹底，新舊界面脫開，水沿界面滲入梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕。~Opening to traffic before strength is reached shatters blockout concrete around the anchors, so the joint loosens and bangs within weeks; incomplete breakout leaves a debonded new-to-old interface that lets water reach the girder end and corrode reinforcement.
units.misconception: 後澆混凝土只要外觀硬化，就可以開放重車通行。~Once blockout concrete looks hard, heavy trucks can be allowed back.
units.practice: 開放交通的條件以成熟度或試體強度表示，而不是以時間表示，並由監造書面放行；施工計畫須依季節預估養護時間並預留應變時段，冬季考慮加溫養護。~Express release to traffic as a maturity or specimen-strength criterion rather than elapsed time, with written release by the supervising engineer; the construction plan estimates curing time by season with contingency, and heated curing is considered in winter.

units.anchor: 安裝預設開口~Installation preset opening
units.title: 安裝溫度與預設開口~Installation temperature and preset opening
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫在工廠以某一開口製造並以臨時夾具固定，安裝時必須依當下的結構溫度與尚未發生的乾縮潛變，調整到正確的預設開口：天氣熱時梁比平均長，開口應較窄；未來還會發生的單向縮短會讓伸縮縫逐漸張開，因此新建混凝土橋在安裝時要再預先收窄一些。預設錯誤的伸縮縫一開始就偏向行程的一端，往後在極端溫度時就會頂死或拉脫。量測要用結構實際溫度，而不是氣溫。~A joint is manufactured at a set opening and held by temporary clamps; at installation it must be adjusted to the correct preset opening for the current structure temperature and the shrinkage and creep still to come: in hot weather the girder is longer than average so the opening should be narrower, and future one-way shortening will gradually open the joint, so new concrete bridges are set a little narrower still. A joint preset wrongly starts biased towards one end of its range and later jams or pulls apart at extreme temperatures. The measurement must use actual structure temperature, not air temperature.
units.model: 4 間隙共 320 mm 的伸縮縫中位開口 160 mm、參考溫度 20°C、伸縮長度 300 m。安裝時結構溫度 32°C，梁較中位長 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm；未來尚有一半乾縮潛變 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm 會使縫張開。預設開口 = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm。數值為教學假設。~A 4-gap, 320 mm joint has a mid opening of 160 mm at a 20°C reference, with a 300 m expansion length. At a structure temperature of 32°C the girder is 10×10⁻⁶×300,000×12 = 36 mm longer than at mid; half the shrinkage and creep, 0.5×(60 + 64) ≈ 62 mm, is still to come and will open the joint. Preset opening = 160 − 36 − 62 ≈ 62 mm. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝當天以埋設或表面溫度計量測梁體平均溫度（避免日照直射時段），依預設表計算開口，現場以量規量測各間隙並記錄；夾具拆除前確認預設正確並經監造簽認，拆除後再量一次並記錄當時溫度。~On the day, measure the girder's average temperature with embedded or surface thermometers away from direct sun, calculate the opening from the preset table, gauge and record every gap; before releasing clamps confirm the preset and obtain the supervising engineer's signature, then measure again after release and record the temperature.
units.failure: 以中午氣溫推算預設值而非結構溫度，開口設得過寬，冬季縫隙超過行程、止水帶拉斷；忘記扣除未來乾縮潛變，伸縮縫幾年後就長期偏開，夏季行程又不足而頂死，把力量推到梁端與墩頂。~Presetting from noon air temperature instead of structure temperature sets the opening too wide, so winter gaps exceed the range and seals tear; forgetting future shrinkage and creep leaves the joint permanently wide after a few years and short of range in summer, jamming and pushing force into girder ends and pier tops.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫照工廠出貨的開口直接安裝即可。~A joint can be installed at the opening it left the factory with.
units.practice: 設計文件應提供以結構溫度為變數的預設開口表，並說明殘餘乾縮潛變的假設；安裝與夾具拆除列為停留點，量測溫度、開口與時間的紀錄須隨竣工資料保存。~Design documents should give a preset table with structure temperature as the variable and state the assumed remaining shrinkage and creep; installation and clamp release are hold points, and the measured temperature, opening and time are kept with the as-built records.

units.anchor: 分幅更換與臨時鋪板~Staged replacement and temporary plates
units.title: 通車條件下的分階段更換~Staged replacement under traffic
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫更換多半必須在不中斷交通的情況下進行：先封閉部分車道，拆除該幅舊伸縮縫與後澆混凝土，安裝新單元並與相鄰段焊接或栓接，澆置養護後開放，再轉換到另一幅。Øresund 橋 2025 年更換第一座旋轉橫梁伸縮縫時保留了既有錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱，只更換伸縮縫單元，並以兩階段三部分施工，先換中段、交通走外側，再換外側兩段；營運單位公告此類大型伸縮縫更換須限制為單向一車道約八週。分段接頭處的焊接與對位品質，決定了日後是否成為疲勞弱點。~Joint replacement usually has to proceed without stopping traffic: some lanes are closed, the old joint and blockout concrete in that width are removed, the new unit is installed and welded or bolted to the adjacent part, the blockout is cast and cured and the lanes reopened before moving to the next width. When the Øresund Bridge replaced its first swivel-joist joint in 2025, the traverse boxes anchored in the concrete were kept and only the joint unit was exchanged, in two stages and three parts: first the middle part with traffic outside, then the two outer parts; the operator announced that such large joint replacements limit traffic to one lane each way for about eight weeks. The quality of welding and alignment at the splices between parts decides whether they become fatigue weak points.
units.model: 每一幅的工期 = 拆除 10 h + 安裝 8 h + 分段焊接 6 h + 後澆養護。20°C 時養護 30 h，每幅 54 h，兩幅 108 h；10°C 時養護 45 h，每幅 69 h，兩幅 138 h，多出約 28%。若保留錨碇箱只換單元，拆除時間可再縮短。數值為教學假設。~Each width takes breakout 10 h + installation 8 h + splice welding 6 h + blockout curing. At 20°C curing is 30 h, so 54 h per width and 108 h for two; at 10°C curing is 45 h, so 69 h per width and 138 h for two, about 28% longer. Keeping the anchorage boxes and changing only the unit can shorten breakout further. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 更換前詳細調查舊伸縮縫的錨碇、梁端與支承狀況，決定保留或重建錨碇；交通維持計畫須經主管機關核准，臨時鋪板的承載與固定須經計算；分段接頭的焊接程序事先評定，現場焊後以超音波或磁粉檢測，接頭高差與平整度量測合格才開放。~Before replacement, survey the old joint's anchorage, girder ends and bearings in detail to decide whether to keep or rebuild the anchorage; the traffic management plan needs authority approval and temporary plates need calculated capacity and fixing; splice welding procedures are qualified in advance, site welds tested by ultrasonics or magnetic particle, and the joint opens only after step and flatness checks pass.
units.failure: 分幅施工時新舊段在接頭處高程不一，形成跳車並加速接頭疲勞；臨時鋪板固定不良被車輛帶起，造成交通事故；拆除時損傷梁端鋼筋或預力錨頭而未發現，日後成為結構弱點。~In staged work, mismatched levels at the new-to-old splice create a bump that accelerates fatigue at the splice; badly fixed temporary plates are lifted by traffic and cause accidents; damage to girder-end reinforcement or prestress anchorages during breakout goes unnoticed and becomes a structural weakness.
units.misconception: 更換伸縮縫只是拆舊換新，與結構安全無關，可由鋪面工班自行處理。~Replacing a joint is just swapping old for new, unrelated to structural safety, and can be left to the paving crew.
units.practice: 更換工程須有結構工程師參與，鑿除時規定保護梁端鋼筋與預力錨頭的方法；每一幅完成後的開放條件（強度、焊接檢測、高差）列為停留點並由監造簽認，交通維持與臨時鋪板由交通工程師負責。~Replacement work needs a structural engineer, with specified methods to protect girder-end reinforcement and prestress anchorages during breakout; the release conditions for each width (strength, weld testing, flushness) are hold points signed by the supervising engineer, and traffic management and temporary plates are a traffic engineer's responsibility.

units.anchor: 疲勞與水密試驗~Fatigue and watertightness tests
units.title: 出廠疲勞、水密與型式認證~Factory fatigue, watertightness and type approval
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫在現場很難做全尺寸試驗，因此性能主要靠型式試驗與出廠檢驗保證：模組式伸縮縫的中梁與支撐梁連接要做疲勞試驗，止水帶要做水密與耐候試驗，控制系統要做開合循環試驗；歐洲以技術認證指引規範這些項目，美國則在 AASHTO 規範中要求模組式伸縮縫的疲勞試驗。疲勞試驗常以加大的應力幅加速，換算回設計交通下的等效循環次數。~Joints are hard to test full scale on site, so performance is assured mainly by type tests and factory inspection: centre-beam-to-support-bar connections in modular joints undergo fatigue tests, seals undergo watertightness and weathering tests, and control systems undergo opening–closing cycle tests; in Europe a technical-approval guideline covers these items, and in the US AASHTO requires fatigue testing of modular joints. Fatigue tests are often accelerated at a higher stress range and converted back to equivalent cycles under design traffic.
units.model: S–N 曲線 m = 3 時，等效循環 N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³。設計交通在 30 MPa 下相當於 2×10⁸ 次，試驗以 60 MPa 進行，等效次數 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ 次，仍需長時間試驗，故常再以更高應力幅或規範規定的試驗程序執行。數值為教學假設。~With an m = 3 S–N curve, equivalent cycles N_t = N_d·(Δσ_d/Δσ_t)³. Design traffic equivalent to 2×10⁸ cycles at 30 MPa, tested at 60 MPa, needs 2×10⁸×(30/60)³ = 2.5×10⁷ cycles, still a long test, so higher stress ranges or code-prescribed procedures are commonly used. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 審查製造商的型式認證、疲勞試驗報告與試驗試體是否與供貨細部一致；出廠時檢查中梁焊縫的非破壞檢測、防蝕塗裝厚度、止水帶安裝與全行程開合，並在工廠做局部注水試驗確認無滲漏。~Review the manufacturer's type approval and fatigue test reports and check that test specimens match the supplied details; at dispatch inspect centre-beam weld NDT, corrosion-protection coating thickness, seal installation and full-range cycling, and run a local water test in the shop to confirm no leakage.
units.failure: 供貨細部與試驗試體不同（例如改了焊接型式或支撐間距），疲勞試驗結果就不再適用，伸縮縫在通車數年內出現中梁焊縫裂縫；止水帶材料未經耐候驗證，在紫外線與臭氧下硬化龜裂而漏水。~If supplied details differ from the test specimens, for example a changed weld type or support spacing, the fatigue results no longer apply and centre-beam welds crack within a few years of opening; seal material not proven for weathering hardens and cracks under UV and ozone and leaks.
units.misconception: 只要伸縮縫的位移量符合需求，就不需要審查疲勞試驗資料。~If a joint has enough movement capacity, its fatigue test data need not be reviewed.
units.practice: 招標文件應要求提送與供貨一致的型式試驗與疲勞試驗報告，並規定出廠檢驗的見證項目；任何細部變更都需重新證明性能並經設計單位同意。~Tender documents should require type and fatigue test reports matching the supplied product and define witnessed factory inspections; any detail change requires renewed proof of performance and the designer's approval.

units.title: 現場驗收與間隙溫度關係量測~Site acceptance and gap–temperature measurement
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫安裝後的行為是檢驗整個伸縮系統的好指標：若結構能自由伸縮，伸縮縫間隙應隨結構溫度線性變化，斜率等於 α 乘伸縮長度。量測多個季節的間隙與溫度，若斜率明顯偏小，表示某處被約束，例如活動支承卡住、梁端頂到橋台背牆或固定點位置與設計不同；若間隙隨時間單向張開，則反映乾縮潛變的進展。這種量測簡單但資訊豐富，適合列入驗收與定期檢查。~A joint's behaviour after installation is a good indicator of the whole movement system: if the structure moves freely, the gap varies linearly with structure temperature at a slope equal to α times the expansion length. Measuring gap and temperature across several seasons, a markedly lower slope points to restraint somewhere, such as a seized sliding bearing, a girder end bearing against the abutment backwall or a fixed point different from design; a gap opening steadily over time reflects ongoing shrinkage and creep. The measurement is simple but rich in information and suits acceptance and routine inspection.
units.model: 理論斜率 dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C。若現場迴歸得 2.4 mm/°C，等效伸縮長度 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m，比設計少 60 m，提示有支承被卡住或固定點偏移。數值為教學假設。~Theoretical slope dg/dT = α·L = 10×10⁻⁶×300,000 mm = 3.0 mm/°C. A field regression of 2.4 mm/°C gives an equivalent expansion length of 2.4/(10×10⁻⁶) = 240,000 mm = 240 m, 60 m less than design, suggesting a seized bearing or a shifted fixed point. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 驗收時量測縫面與鋪面高差、各間隙寬度、排水槽暢通與注水防漏，並在伸縮縫兩側設固定量測點；之後每次檢查記錄間隙與結構溫度，累積資料做迴歸，斜率或截距偏離預測時，安排支承與梁端詳細檢查。~At acceptance measure the step between joint and pavement, each gap width, trough drainage and a water leak test, and set fixed measuring points on both sides of the joint; at every later inspection record gap and structure temperature, regress the accumulated data and arrange detailed checks of bearings and girder ends if slope or intercept departs from prediction.
units.failure: 只看伸縮縫外觀而不量間隙，活動支承因腐蝕卡住多年未被發現，溫度力由墩柱承受而在墩底開裂；間隙長期單向張開未被追蹤，直到止水帶拉脫漏水才察覺。~Looking only at the joint's appearance without measuring gaps lets a sliding bearing seized by corrosion go unnoticed for years while the piers take the temperature forces and crack at the base; steady one-way opening goes untracked until seals pull out and leak.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫的間隙每天都在變，量測它沒有意義。~Joint gaps change every day, so measuring them is meaningless.
units.practice: 竣工資料應提供每一伸縮縫的設計間隙—溫度曲線與量測點位置，檢查表格以溫度與間隙成對記錄；偏離預測的趨勢須通報結構工程師評估。~As-built records should provide each joint's design gap–temperature line and measuring points, with inspection forms recording temperature and gap in pairs; trends departing from prediction are reported to the structural engineer for assessment.

units.anchor: 止水帶與排水槽~Seals and drainage trough
units.title: 漏水、劣化模式與維護~Leakage, deterioration modes and maintenance
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫最常見也最昂貴的問題不是伸縮縫本身，而是它漏水：含除冰鹽或海鹽的水穿過破損止水帶，落在支承、墩帽與梁端，造成鋼筋腐蝕、支承鏽蝕與混凝土剝落，修復下部結構的費用常遠高於更換伸縮縫。其他劣化模式包括碎石堆積使間隙無法閉合、止水帶老化撕裂、中梁焊縫疲勞、錨碇鬆動與噪音。維護重點是定期清除碎石、檢查並更換止水帶、確認排水槽通暢，並記錄異常噪音與跳車。~The commonest and costliest joint problem is not the joint itself but leakage: water carrying de-icing or sea salt passes through damaged seals onto bearings, pier caps and girder ends, corroding reinforcement and bearings and spalling concrete, and repairing the substructure often costs far more than replacing the joint. Other deterioration modes include debris packing that stops gaps closing, ageing and tearing seals, fatigue of centre-beam welds, loosened anchorages and noise. Maintenance focuses on regular debris removal, inspecting and renewing seals, keeping drainage troughs clear and logging unusual noise and bumps.
units.model: 橋面集水面積 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² 流向伸縮縫，降雨強度 50 mm/h 時水量 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h；若止水帶破損使 10% 漏下，每小時約 2.4 m³ 的水直接落在支承與墩帽上，一年多次豪雨即足以使鹽分持續累積。數值為教學假設。~With a deck catchment of 16 m × 30 m = 480 m² draining towards the joint and 50 mm/h rainfall, the flow is 480×0.05 = 24 m³/h; if a damaged seal lets 10% leak, about 2.4 m³ an hour falls directly on bearings and pier caps, and a few heavy storms a year are enough for salt to keep accumulating. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 定期檢查時由橋下目視墩帽與支承有無水漬、鏽水與白華，由橋面檢查止水帶完整性與碎石堆積；必要時做注水試驗確認漏點，並把結果與上次檢查比較，止水帶破損列為限期修復項目。~At routine inspections look from below for water stains, rust and efflorescence on pier caps and bearings, and from the deck for seal integrity and debris; where needed, run a water test to locate leaks and compare with the previous inspection, treating damaged seals as a time-limited repair item.
units.failure: 止水帶小破洞多年未修，墩帽頂面長期潮濕含鹽，支承底板鏽蝕失去滑動功能、墩帽保護層剝落露筋，最後必須頂升梁體更換支承並修補墩帽，費用與封閉時間都遠超過更換止水帶。~A small hole in a seal left for years keeps the pier cap wet and salty, the bearing base plate rusts and stops sliding and the cap spalls to expose reinforcement, until the girder must be jacked to replace bearings and repair the cap, at far greater cost and closure time than renewing the seal.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫漏一點水不影響結構安全，可以等全面更換時再處理。~A little leakage through a joint does not affect structural safety and can wait until full replacement.
units.practice: 維護手冊應規定清掃與檢查週期、止水帶更換方法與備品、排水槽清理方式，並把伸縮縫下方的墩帽與支承列為同一檢查單元；止水帶設計宜可從橋面更換，不需拆除整座伸縮縫。~The maintenance manual should define cleaning and inspection intervals, seal replacement methods and spares and trough cleaning, treating the pier cap and bearings below the joint as part of the same inspection unit; seals should be replaceable from the deck without removing the whole joint.

units.anchor: 伸縮縫生命週期紀錄~Joint life-cycle records
units.title: 更換策略、可更換設計與交接~Replacement strategy, replaceable design and handover
units.mechanism: 伸縮縫的使用年限通常遠短於橋梁本身，所以在橋梁一生中會被更換數次；設計時就把更換納入考量，可以大幅縮短未來的封閉時間。例子包括 Øresund 橋保留錨碇在混凝土中的橫梁箱、只更換伸縮縫單元，以及漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋 2014 至 2016 年翻修時採用可快速拆除、不需動到瀝青與混凝土的 QUICK-EX 系統。交接文件應記錄每一座伸縮縫的型式、預設、安裝溫度、試驗報告與檢查歷程，讓下一次更換可以事先規劃。~Joints usually last far less than the bridge, so they are replaced several times in its life, and designing for replacement greatly shortens future closures. Examples include the Øresund Bridge keeping the traverse boxes anchored in concrete and replacing only the joint unit, and Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge using the QUICK-EX system in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation so joints can be removed quickly without disturbing asphalt or concrete. Handover documents should record each joint's type, preset, installation temperature, test reports and inspection history so the next replacement can be planned in advance.
units.model: 橋梁設計年限 100 年、伸縮縫壽命 25 年：一生中需更換 100/25 − 1 = 3 次。全橋 8 座伸縮縫，若每座需鑿除錨碇重建、封閉 6 天，總計 3×8×6 = 144 天；若保留錨碇只換單元、每座 3.5 天，總計 84 天，減少約 42%。數值為教學假設。~With a 100-year bridge and a 25-year joint life, 100/25 − 1 = 3 replacements are needed. For 8 joints, rebuilding the anchorage at 6 closure days each totals 3×8×6 = 144 days; keeping the anchorage and changing only the unit at 3.5 days each totals 84 days, about 42% less. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 交接前清點每一座伸縮縫的資料：製造圖、型式與疲勞試驗報告、出廠檢驗、預設與安裝溫度紀錄、驗收量測、備品清單與更換程序，並確認營運單位已建立間隙—溫度與漏水檢查的基準資料。~Before handover, check each joint's records: shop drawings, type and fatigue test reports, factory inspection, preset and installation-temperature records, acceptance measurements, spare-parts list and replacement procedure, and confirm the owner has baselines for gap–temperature and leakage inspections.
units.failure: 交接資料缺漏，十多年後更換伸縮縫時不知道原設計位移、錨碇細部與預設方法，只能保守地全部鑿除重建，封閉時間與成本倍增；若新伸縮縫型式與舊錨碇不相容，還需修改梁端結構。~With incomplete handover records, a replacement a decade or two later cannot know the original design movements, anchorage details or presetting method, so everything is conservatively broken out and rebuilt, multiplying closure time and cost; a new joint incompatible with the old anchorage may even require changes to the girder ends.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫壞了再換即可，設計時不必考慮更換方式。~A joint can simply be replaced when it fails; its replacement need not be considered in design.
units.practice: 設計規格應要求伸縮縫可在部分車道封閉下分幅更換、錨碇可保留、止水帶可從橋面更換；交接文件包含上述全部紀錄與更換程序，並由營運單位指定專人管理伸縮縫資產資料。~Design specifications should require joints to be replaceable width by width under partial lane closures, with retainable anchorages and seals renewable from the deck; handover includes all the records above and the replacement procedure, and the owner assigns a person to manage joint asset data.

example: 選型練習：一座鋼橋伸縮長度 480 m，α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，結構溫度範圍 −5 至 +55°C（ΔT = 60°C）：溫度位移 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm；加上活載轉角與煞車往復 ±20 mm 共 40 mm，合計約 386 mm。若模組式每間隙 80 mm，需 386/80 ≈ 4.8，取 5 個間隙（400 mm），中位開口 200 mm（每間隙 40 mm），參考溫度 25°C。安裝時結構溫度 35°C，梁較中位長 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm，預設總開口 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm，平均每間隙約 28.5 mm。若耐震要求另需容納 150 mm 地震位移，總需求約 536 mm，需 536/80 ≈ 6.7，取 7 個間隙；或改採在地震時允許犧牲、事後快速更換的設計，兩者須與業主的震後通行目標一起比較。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的設計。~Selection exercise: a steel bridge has a 480 m expansion length, α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C and a structure temperature range of −5 to +55°C (ΔT = 60°C), so thermal movement is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×60 ≈ 346 mm; adding ±20 mm, 40 mm in all, for live-load rotation and braking gives about 386 mm. At 80 mm per modular gap, 386/80 ≈ 4.8, so 5 gaps (400 mm) with a mid opening of 200 mm (40 mm per gap) at a 25°C reference. Installed at a structure temperature of 35°C, the girder is 12×10⁻⁶×480,000×10 ≈ 58 mm longer than at mid, so the preset total opening is 200 − 58 ≈ 142 mm, about 28.5 mm per gap. If seismic design also requires 150 mm of earthquake displacement, the demand becomes about 536 mm, needing 536/80 ≈ 6.7, so 7 gaps; alternatively a design that may be sacrificed in an earthquake and quickly replaced afterwards can be compared, together with the owner's post-earthquake access objective. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design of any real bridge.
history: 早期橋梁多以鋼板滑動縫或簡單的開口縫處理梁端位移，隨著長跨鋼橋與預力混凝土橋的發展，位移量增加到數百公釐以上，多間隙的模組式伸縮縫與旋轉橫梁伸縮縫在歐洲發展成熟，並以疲勞與水密試驗建立型式認證制度。漢堡 Köhlbrand 橋原於 1974 年完工，2014 至 2016 年翻修時換裝位移達 760 至 1,140 mm 的模組式伸縮縫；紐約新 Tappan Zee 橋在 2015 至 2018 年安裝 23 座模組式伸縮縫，最大的 LR18 位移可達約 1.4 m；2000 年通車的 Øresund 橋則於 2025 年春季完成第一座 DS15 旋轉橫梁伸縮縫的更換，其餘預定在 2026 至 2030 年陸續進行。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Early bridges handled girder-end movement with sliding steel plates or simple open gaps; as long steel spans and prestressed concrete bridges raised movements to hundreds of millimetres and more, multi-gap modular joints and swivel-joist joints matured in Europe, with type approval based on fatigue and watertightness testing. Hamburg's Köhlbrand Bridge, completed in 1974, received modular joints with movements of 760 to 1,140 mm in its 2014–2016 rehabilitation; New York's new Tappan Zee crossing installed 23 modular joints between 2015 and 2018, the largest LR18 units taking about 1.4 m; and the Øresund Bridge, opened in 2000, completed the replacement of its first DS15 swivel-joist joint in spring 2025, with the rest planned for 2026 to 2030. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 新 Tappan Zee 橋安裝 23 座模組式伸縮縫，最大 LR18 有 18 個間隙、位移可達約 54 in（1.4 m），最長單元 105 ft~The new Tappan Zee crossing has 23 modular joints; the largest LR18 has 18 gaps and up to about 54 in (1.4 m) of movement, the longest unit 105 ft
Tappan Zee 另裝 16 具鎖定裝置，鎖定容量約 800 kips（3,550 kN）~The Tappan Zee crossing also has 16 lock-up devices with about 800 kips (3,550 kN) capacity
Øresund 橋共有 8 座旋轉橫梁伸縮縫，DS15 以 15 個型材容納約 1,500 mm 位移~The Øresund Bridge has 8 swivel-joist joints; the DS15 takes about 1,500 mm of movement with 15 profiles

Øresund 更換的伸縮縫單元重約 22 t、長約 25 m，2025 年春季完成第一座，其餘預定 2026 至 2030 年~The Øresund replacement unit weighs about 22 t and is about 25 m long; the first was done in spring 2025, the rest planned for 2026 to 2030
Øresund 營運單位公告大型伸縮縫更換期間單向限一車道約 8 週~The Øresund operator announced about 8 weeks of one lane each way for its large joint replacements

Köhlbrand 橋全長 3,618 m，2014 至 2016 年換裝位移 760 mm 與 1,140 mm 的模組式伸縮縫，每日約 30,000 車次~Köhlbrand Bridge is 3,618 m long, received modular joints for 760 mm and 1,140 mm in 2014–2016 and carries about 30,000 vehicles a day
一般橋梁伸縮縫位移約 30 至 1,000 mm，模組式約 160 mm 至 3,000 mm 以上~Bridge joints typically handle about 30 to 1,000 mm, modular joints about 160 mm to over 3,000 mm
300 m 混凝土橋在 50°C 溫度範圍下伸縮約 150 mm~A 300 m concrete bridge moves about 150 mm over a 50°C temperature range
